scientific_integrity: The exact laws and asymptotics have analytic proofs; independent random simulation only checks the finite-sample formulas. A published equivalent formulation elsewhere is not excluded by database searches.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one three-dimensional Hermitian diagonal model, a fixed two-dimensional trial space and square complex-Gaussian test matrices; exact unrefined generalized Ritz values; no oversampling, real-Gaussian claim, universal-matrix assertion or nontrivial algorithmic speed claim.
title: Exact complex-Gaussian randomized Ritz tails and a logarithmic mean-angle penalty
